newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers dull on South Korean competition.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers dull on South Korean competition.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices on Wednesday were little moved amid thin enquires and cheaper South Korean prices, brokers said.
A shipowner told Reuters that Singapore prices remained high and he plans to bunker in South Korea. Bunker 180 cst in South Korea was indicated at $115-$116, $5 cheaper than Singapore.

Enquires in Singapore were thin as prices were too strong, said a seller. Bunker 180 cst was quoted at $120-122 and 380-cst at $118-$120, compared with $121-$122 and $117-$119 respectively on Tuesday. MDO and gas oil were steady at $200-$205 and $215-$216 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
